extracted.stage: Before grant of probate; inheritance tax due
extracted.summary: An executor of her late mother's estate, mostly a Harrogate property worth around £814,000, asks to borrow about £43,000 to pay inheritance tax before the grant of probate is issued.
extracted.draft_reply: Thank you for your enquiry about funding the inheritance tax on your late mother's estate. We have noted the figures you mention and that Szabo Solicitors LLP are instructed. To take this further we would need a copy of the will and details of your appointment as executor, a breakdown of the estate's assets and liabilities including the Harrogate property valuation, confirmation of the HMRC amount due and any payment deadline, and your solicitor's contact details and consent to liaise with them. Once we have those we will review the enquiry and come back to you; nothing in this message should be taken as an offer or an indication of terms.
